answer: Co-occurrence relic scoring. Log each pair of identities that transact, then retroactively score clusters by reuse of rare attributes (device fingerprints, timing offsets, IP umber ranges). Enforcement rule: nodes whose attribute overlap exceeds a background rate are quarantined and their past gains clawed back. An attacker must farm distinct fingerprints, karst-like separation in timing, and fresh hardware per identity; the per-identity cost scales with real diversification, not registration. Residual linkage risks expose whole clusters.
